# ADR-3081: A07: Prefer phishing-resistant MFA for workforce 9

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

OTP MFA is phishable at scale.

## Decision

Workforce IAM SHOULD prefer phishing-resistant MFA for workforce 9 (A07-9) when rolling out stronger factors.

## Consequences

WebAuthn/passkeys are the target state.
